contentPattern.structure: per slide: customer quote (callout) + small avatar + author name + location; Prev/Next controls

suitableFor: rotating customer testimonial / review sliders with Previous/Next controls
quote carousels where each slide is a short quote + attribution (name + location)
social-proof sections cycling through several short customer quotes
notSuitableFor: promotional hero sliders with image + heading + description + CTA per slide (use carousel-hero)
a single, non-rotating highlighted quotation (use the quote block)

usage.notes: Admiral homepage testimonials slider. 3 unique testimonials (Mahjabeen/Ilford, Stefan/Manchester, Deborah/Wallasey); slick-cloned duplicates in the source DOM are runtime artifacts and excluded. Avatar image is a generic placeholder shared across slides.
